o: Después de las primeras semanas de romper con Elena, una noche no pude evitar asistir a un baile.
t: After the first weeks of breaking up with Elena, one night I could not avoid going to a dance.

o: Hallábame hacía largo rato sentado y aburrido en exceso, cuando Julio Zapiola, viéndome allí, vino a saludarme.
t: I had been sitting there for a long while, excessively bored, when Julio Zapiola, seeing me there, came over to greet me.

o: Es un hombre joven, dotado de rara elegancia y virilidad de carácter.
t: He is a young man, endowed with rare elegance and virility of character.

o: Lo había estimado muchos años atrás, y entonces volvía de Europa, después de larga ausencia.
t: I had esteemed him many years earlier, and now he was returning from Europe after a long absence.

o: Así nuestra charla, que en otra ocasión no hubiera pasado de ocho o diez frases, se prolongó esta vez en larga y desahogada sinceridad.
t: Thus our conversation, which on another occasion would not have gone beyond eight or ten sentences, was prolonged this time into a long and unburdened frankness.

o: Supe que se había casado; su mujer estaba allí mismo esa noche.
t: I learned that he had married; his wife was there that very night.

o: Por mi parte, lo informé de mi noviazgo con Elena--y su reciente ruptura.
t: For my part, I told him of my courtship with Elena—and their recent breakup.

o: Posiblemente me quejé de la amarga situación, pues recuerdo haberle dicho que creía de todo punto imposible cualquier arreglo.
t: Possibly I complained about the bitter situation, since I recall telling him that I considered any arrangement utterly impossible.

o: --No crea en esas sacudidas--me dijo Zapiola con aire tranquilo y serio.--Casi nunca se sabe al principio lo que pasará o se hará después.
t: "Don't believe in those shocks," Zapiola told me with a calm and serious air. "Almost never is it known at the beginning what will happen or be done afterward."

o: Yo tengo en mi matrimonio una novela infinitamente más complicada que la suya; lo cual no obsta para que yo sea hoy el marido más feliz de la tierra.
t: In my marriage I have a novel infinitely more complicated than yours; which does not prevent me from being today the happiest husband on earth.

o: Oigala, porque a usted podrá serle de gran provecho.
t: Listen to her, because it may be of great profit to you.

o: Hace cinco años me vi con gran frecuencia con Vezzera, un amigo del colegio a quien había querido mucho antes, y sobre todo él a mí.
t: Five years ago I saw Vezzera very often, a friend from school whom I had long liked, and he me above all.

o: Cuanto prometía el muchacho se realizó plenamente en el hombre; era como antes inconstante, apasionado, con depresiones y exaltamientos femeniles.
t: Everything the boy had promised was fully realized in the man; he was as before inconstant, passionate, with feminine depressions and exaltations.

o: Todas sus ansias y suspicacias eran enfermizas, y usted no ignora de qué modo se sufre y se hace sufrir con este modo de ser.
t: All his longings and suspicions were morbid, and you do not ignore how one suffers, and makes others suffer, with this way of being.

o: Un día me dijo que estaba enamorado, y que posiblemente se casaría muy pronto.
t: One day he told me he was in love, and that he would very likely get married soon.

o: Aunque me habló con loco entusiasmo de la belleza de su novia, esta apreciación suya de la hermosura en cuestión no tenía para mí ningún valor.
t: Although he spoke to me with wild enthusiasm of his girlfriend's beauty, this appreciation of hers held no value for me.

o: Vezzera insistió, irritándose con mi orgullo.
t: Vezzera insisted, growing irritated at my pride.

o: --No sé qué tiene que ver el orgullo con esto--le observé.
t: "I don't see what pride has to do with this," I observed.

o: Yo soy enfermizo, excitable, expuesto a continuos mirajes y debo equivocarme siempre.
t: I am sickly, excitable, prone to constant illusions, and I must always be wrong.

o: ¡Tú, no! ¡Lo que dices es la ponderación justa de lo que has visto!
t: You, though! What you say is the just measure of what you have seen!

o: --¡Bah; déjame en paz!--concluyó cada vez más irritado con mi tranquilidad, que era para él otra manifestación de orgullo.
t: "Bah, leave me alone!" he concluded, each time more irritated by my calmness, which for him was another manifestation of pride.

o: Cada vez que volví a verlo en los días sucesivos, lo hallé más exaltado con su amor.
t: Every time I saw him again in the days that followed, I found him more exalted with his love.

o: Estaba más delgado, y sus ojos cargados de ojeras brillaban de fiebre.
t: He was thinner, and his eyes, heavy with dark circles, shone with fever.

o: --¿Quiere hacer una cosa?
t: "Would you like to do something?"

o: Vamos esta noche a su casa.
t: Let us go to her house tonight.

o: Ya le he hablado de ti.
t: I have already spoken to her about you.

o: Vas a ver si es o no como te he dicho.
t: You will see whether she is as I told you or not.

o: Fuimos. No sé si usted ha sufrido una impresión semejante; pero cuando ella me extendió la mano y nos miramos, sentí que por ese contacto tibio, la espléndida belleza de aquellos ojos sombríos y de aquel cuerpo mudo, se infiltraba en una caliente onda en todo mi ser.
t: We went. I do not know whether you have ever suffered a like impression; but when she held out her hand to me and we looked at each other, I felt that through that warm contact, the splendid beauty of those shadowy eyes and that silent body seeped into me in a hot wave through my whole being.

o: Cuando salimos, Vezzera me dijo.
t: When we came out, Vezzera said to me.

o: --¿Y?... ¿es como te he dicho?
t: "And?... Is she as I told you?"

o: --Sí--le respondí.
t: "Yes," I answered.

o: --¿La gente impresionable puede entonces comunicar una impresión conforme a la realidad?
t: --Can the impressionable person then convey an impression that matches reality?

o: --Esta vez, sí--no pude menos de reirme.
t: --This time, yes--I couldn't help but laugh.

o: Vezzera me miró de reojo y se calló por largo rato.
t: Vezzera glanced at me sideways and fell silent for a long while.

o: --¡Parece--me dijo de pronto--que no hicieras sino concederme por suma gracia su belleza!
t: --It seems--he said to me suddenly--that you did nothing but grant me her beauty out of sheer grace!

o: --¿Pero estás loco?--le respondí.
t: --Are you out of your mind?--I answered him.

o: Vezzera se encogió de hombros como si yo hubiera esquivado su respuesta.
t: Vezzera shrugged as if I had dodged his answer.

o: Siguió sin hablarme, visiblemente disgustado, hasta que al fin volvió otra vez a mí sus ojos de fiebre.
t: He went on not speaking to me, visibly displeased, until at last he turned his feverish eyes on me again.

o: --De veras, de veras me juras que te parece linda?
t: --Honestly, honestly, do you swear to me that you think she's lovely?

o: Me parece lindísima; ¿quieres más?
t: I think she's lovely; do you want more than that?

o: Se calmó entonces, y con la reacción inevitable de sus nervios femeninos, pasó conmigo una hora de loco entusiasmo, abrasándose al recuerdo de su novia.
t: He calmed down then, and with the inevitable reaction of his feminine nerves, he spent an hour with me in mad enthusiasm, growing heated over the memory of his girlfriend.

o: Fui varias veces más con Vezzera.
t: I went out with Vezzera several more times.

o: Una noche, a una nueva invitación, respondí que no me hallaba bien y que lo dejaríamos para otro momento.
t: One night, on a new invitation, I answered that I wasn't feeling well and that we would put it off for another time.

o: Diez días más tarde respondí lo mismo, y de igual modo en la siguiente semana.
t: Ten days later I gave the same answer, and likewise the following week.

o: Esta vez Vezzera me miró fijamente a los ojos.
t: This time Vezzera stared straight into my eyes.

o: --¿Por qué no quieres ir?
t: --Why don't you want to go?

o: --No es que no quiera ir, sino que me hallo hoy con poco humor para esas cosas.
t: --It's not that I don't want to go, but that today I'm in no mood for those things.

o: ¡Es que no quieres ir más!
t: It's that you don't want to go anymore!

o: --Sí; y te exijo como a un amigo, o como a ti, que me digas justamente esto: ¿Por qué no quieres ir más?
t: --Yes; and I demand of you, as a friend, or as yourself, that you tell me precisely this: why don't you want to go anymore?

o: --¡No tengo ganas!... ¿Te gusta?
t: --I don't feel like it!... Do you like her?

o: Vezzera me miró como miran los tuberculosos condenados al reposo, a un hombre fuerte que no se jacta de ello.
t: Vezzera looked at me the way consumptives condemned to rest look at a strong man who doesn't boast of it.

o: Y en realidad, creo que ya se precipitaba su tisis.
t: And really, I think his tuberculosis was already hastening its course.

o: Se observó en seguida las manos sudorosas, que le temblaban.
t: His sweaty hands were immediately noticed, trembling.

o: --Hace días que las noto más flacas...
t: "For days now I've noticed they're thinner..."

o: ¿Sabes por qué no quieres ir más?
t: Do you know why you don't want to go any further?

o: ¿Quieres que te lo diga?
t: Do you want me to tell you?

o: Tenía las ventanas de la nariz contraídas, y su respiración acelerada le cerraba los labios.
t: His nostrils were pinched shut, and his quickened breathing closed his lips.

o: --¡Vamos! No seas... cálmate, que es lo mejor.
t: "Come on! Don't be... calm down, that's the best thing to do."

o: --¡Es que te lo voy a decir!
t: "It's just that I'm going to tell you!"

o: --¿Pero no ves que estás delirando, que estás muerto de fiebre?--le interrumpí.
t: "But don't you see you're delirious, you're burning with fever?"--I interrupted him.

o: Por dicha, un violento acceso de tos lo detuvo.
t: Luckily, a violent fit of coughing stopped him.

o: Lo empujé cariñosamente.
t: I pushed him gently.

o: --Acuéstate un momento... estás mal.
t: "Lie down for a moment... you're not well."

o: Vezzera se recostó en mi cama y cruzó sus dos manos sobre la frente.
t: Vezzera lay back on my bed and crossed both hands over his forehead.

o: Pasó un largo rato en silencio.
t: A long while passed in silence.

o: De pronto me llegó su voz, lenta.
t: Then his voice reached me, slow.

o: --¿Sabes lo que te iba a decir?...
t: "Do you know what I was going to tell you?..."

o: Que no querías que María se enamorara de ti... Por eso no ibas.
t: That you didn't want María to fall in love with you... That's why you weren't going.

o: --¡Qué estúpido!--me sonreí.
t: "What a fool!"--I smiled at him.

o: ¡Todo, todo lo que quieras!
t: Anything, anything you like!

o: Quedamos mudos otra vez.
t: We were both silent again.

o: Al fin me acerqué a él.
t: At last I went up to him.

o: --Esta noche vamos--le dije.--¿Quieres?
t: "Tonight we're going," I told him. "Do you want to?"

o: Cuatro horas más tarde llegábamos allá.
t: Four hours later we arrived there.

o: María me saludó como si hubiera dejado de verme el día anterior, sin parecer en lo más mínimo preocupada de mi larga ausencia.
t: María greeted me as if I had stopped seeing her the day before, without appearing in the slightest worried by my long absence.

o: --Pregúntale siquiera--se rió Vezzera con visible afectación--por qué ha pasado tanto tiempo sin venir.
t: "Ask him, at least," Vezzera laughed with evident affectation, "why he has gone so long without coming."

o: María arrugó imperceptiblemente el ceño, y se volvió a mí con risueña sorpresa.
t: María imperceptibly furrowed her brow, and turned to me with laughing surprise.

o: --¡Pero supongo que no tendría deseo de visitarnos!
t: "But I suppose he has no desire to visit us!"

o: Aunque el tono de la exclamción no pedía respuesta, María quedó un instante en suspenso, como si la esperara.
t: Though the tone of the exclamation called for no answer, María paused for a moment, as if she were waiting for one.

o: Vi que Vezzera me devoraba con los ojos.
t: I saw that Vezzera was devouring me with his eyes.

o: --Aunque deba avergonzarme eternamente--repuse--confieso que hay algo de verdad...
t: "Though I may be ashamed forever," I replied, "I confess there is some truth in it..."

o: --¿No es verdad?--se rió ella.
t: "Isn't there?" she laughed.

o: Pero ya en el movimiento de los pies y en la dilatación de las narices de Vezzera, conocí su tensión de nervios.
t: But already in the movement of his feet and the flaring of Vezzera's nostrils, I knew his nervous tension.

o: --Dile que te diga--se dirigió a María--por qué realmente no quería venir.
t: "Tell him to tell you," he said to María, "why he really didn't want to come."

o: Era tan perverso y cobarde el ataque, que lo miré con verdadera rabia.
t: The attack was so wicked and cowardly that I looked at him with real anger.

o: Vezzera afectó no darse cuenta, y sostuvo la tirante expectativa con el convulsivo golpeteo del pie, mientras María tornaba a contraer las cejas.
t: Vezzera pretended not to notice, and held the taut expectation with the convulsive tapping of his foot, while María's brows contracted again.

o: --¿Hay otra cosa?--se sonrió con esfuerzo.
t: "Is there anything else?" he smiled with effort.

o: --Sí, Zapiola te va a decir...
t: "Yes, Zapiola is going to tell you..."

o: --... Es decir, no el motivo suyo, sino el que yo le atribuía para no venir más aquí... ¿sabes por qué?
t: "... That is, not his own reason, but the one I attributed to him for not coming here again... do you know why?"

o: --Porque él cree que usted se va a enamorar de mí--me adelanté, dirigiéndome a María.
t: "--Because he believes you're going to fall in love with me--" I said, turning to María.

o: Ya antes de decir esto, vi bien claro la ridiculez en que iba a caer; pero tuve que hacerlo.
t: Even before saying this, I clearly saw the ridiculousness into which I was going to fall; but I had to do it.

o: María soltó la risa, notándose así mucho más el cansancio de sus ojos.
t: María burst out laughing, and her tired eyes became all the more noticeable.

o: --¿Sí? ¿Pensabas eso, Antenor?
t: "Really? Were you thinking that, Antenor?"

o: --No, supondrás... era una broma--se rió él también.
t: "No, you suppose... it was a joke--" he laughed too.

o: La madre entró de nuevo en la sala, y la conversación cambió de rumbo.
t: The mother came into the room again, and the conversation changed course.

o: --Eres un canalla--me apresuré a decirle en los ojos a Vezzera, cuando salimos.
t: "You're a swine--" I hurried to say to Vezzera to his face, as we went out.

o: --Sí--me respondió mirándome claramente.--Lo hice a propósito.
t: "Yes--" he answered me, looking at me squarely. "I did it on purpose."

o: --¿Querías ridiculizarme?
t: "Were you trying to make a fool of me?"

o: --¿Y no te da vergüenza?
t: "And aren't you ashamed?"

o: ¿Pero qué diablos te pasa?
t: "What the hell is the matter with you?"

o: ¿Qué tienes contra mí?
t: "What have you got against me?"

o: No me contestó, encogiéndose de hombros.
t: He did not answer me, shrugging his shoulders.

o: Pero un momento después, al separarme, sentí su mirada cruel y desconfiada fija en la mía.
t: But a moment later, as we parted, I felt his cruel, distrustful gaze fixed on mine.

o: --¿Me juras por lo que más quieras, por lo que quieras más, que no sabes lo que pienso?
t: "Do you swear to me by whatever you hold most dear, by whatever you hold dearest, that you don't know what I'm thinking?"

o: --No--le respondí secamente.
t: "No--" I answered him curtly.

o: --¡No mientes, no estás mintiendo?
t: "You're not lying, you're not lying?"

o: Y mentía profundamente.
t: And I was lying deeply.

o: --Bueno, me alegro...
t: "Well, I'm glad..."

o: ¿Cuándo quieres que volvamos allá?
t: When do you want us to go back there?

o: --¡Nunca! Se acabó.
t: "Never! It's over."

o: Vi que verdadera angustia le dilataba los ojos.
t: I saw that real anguish dilated his eyes.

o: --¿No quieres ir más?--me dijo con voz ronca y extraña.
t: "Don't you want to go anymore?" he said to me in a hoarse, strange voice.

o: --Como quieras, mejor...
t: "As you like, better..."

o: No estás enojado, ¿verdad?
t: You're not angry, are you?

o: --¡Oh, no seas criatura!--me reí.
t: "Oh, don't be a baby!" I laughed.

o: Y estaba verdaderamente irritado contra Vezzera, contra mí...
t: And he was truly irritated against Vezzera, against me...

o: Al día siguiente Vezzera entró al anochecer en mi cuarto.
t: The next day Vezzera came into my room at dusk.

o: Llovía desde la mañana, con fuerte temporal, y la humedad y el frío me agobiaban.
t: It had been raining since morning, with a heavy storm, and the damp and the cold overwhelmed me.

o: Desde el primer momento noté que Vezzera ardía en fiebre.
t: From the first moment I noticed that Vezzera was burning with fever.

o: --Vengo a pedirte una cosa--comenzó.
t: "I've come to ask you for something," he began.

o: --¡Déjate de cosas!--interrumpí.--¿Por qué has salido con esta noche?
t: "Stop with that!" I interrupted. "Why have you come out in this weather?"

o: ¿No ves que estás jugando tu vida con esto?
t: Don't you see that you're risking your life with this?

o: --La vida no me importa... dentro de unos meses esto se acaba... mejor.
t: "I don't care about my life... in a few months this will be over... better."

o: Lo que quiero es que vayas otra vez allá.
t: What I want is for you to go back there again.

o: ¡No quiero que no quieras ir!
t: I don't want you not to want to go!

o: ¿Por qué no quieres ir?
t: Why don't you want to go?

o: --Ya te he dicho: ¡no-qui-e-ro!
t: "I've already told you: I don't-wan-t-to!"

o: Ni una palabra más sobre esto, ¿oyes?
t: Not one word more about this, you hear?

o: La angustia de la noche anterior tornó a desmesurarle los ojos.
t: The anguish of the night before made his eyes seem to bulge out of proportion.

o: --Entonces--articuló con voz profundamente tomada--es lo que pienso, lo que tú sabes que yo pensaba cuando mentiste anoche.
t: "So..." he articulated in a voice thick with emotion, "that's what I think, what you know I was thinking when you lied last night."

o: De modo... Bueno, dejemos, no es nada. Hasta mañana.
t: So... Well, let's leave it, it's nothing. Until tomorrow.

o: Lo detuve del hombro y se dejó caer en seguida en la silla, con la cabeza sobre sus brazos en la mesa.
t: I caught him by the shoulder and he immediately let himself drop into the chair, his head resting on his arms on the table.

o: --Quédate--le dije.--Vas a dormir aquí conmigo. No estés solo.
t: "Stay here," I told him. "You're going to sleep here with me. Don't be alone."

o: Durante un rato nos quedamos en profundo silencio.
t: For a while we remained in deep silence.

o: Al fin articuló sin entonación alguna.
t: At last he spoke, without the slightest inflection.

o: --Es que me dan unas ganas locas de matarme...
t: "It's just that I have these crazy urges to kill myself..."

o: --¡Por eso! ¡Quédate aquí!... No estés solo.
t: "That's why! Stay here!... Don't be alone."

o: Pero no pude contenerlo, y pasé toda la noche inquieto.
t: But I couldn't hold it back, and I spent the whole night restless.

o: Usted sabe qué terrible fuerza de atracción tiene el suicidio, cuando la idea fija se ha enredado en una madeja de nervios enfermos.
t: You know what a terrible power of attraction suicide has, once the fixed idea has tangled itself up in a skein of sick nerves.

o: Habría sido menester que a toda costa Vezzera no estuviera solo en su cuarto.
t: It would have been necessary, at all costs, for Vezzera not to be alone in his room.

o: Y aún así, persistía siempre el motivo.
t: And yet the motive always persisted.

o: Pasó lo que temía.
t: What I feared happened.

o: A las siete de la mañana me trajeron una carta de Vezzera, muerto ya desde cuatro horas atrás.
t: At seven in the morning they brought me a letter from Vezzera, dead for four hours already.

o: Me decía en ella que era demasiado claro que yo estaba enamorado de su novia, y ella de mí.
t: In it he told me that it was quite clear that I was in love with his girlfriend, and she with me.

o: Que en cuanto a María, tenía la más completa certidumbre y que yo no había hecho sino confirmarle mi amor con mi negativa a ir más allá.
t: That as for María, he had the most complete certainty, and that I had done nothing but confirm my love for her by refusing to go any further.

o: Que estuviera yo lejos de creer que se mataba de dolor, absolutamente no.
t: That I was far from believing he was killing himself out of pain, absolutely not.

o: Pero él no era hombre capaz de sacrificar a nadie a su egoísta felicidad, y por eso nos dejaba libre a mí y a ella.
t: But he was not a man capable of sacrificing anyone to his selfish happiness, and so he left me and her free.

o: Además, sus pulmones no daban más... era cuestión de tiempo.
t: Besides, his lungs could take no more... it was a matter of time.

o: Que hiciera feliz a María, como él hubiera deseado..., etc.
t: That he made María happy, as he would have wished..., etc.

o: Y dos o tres frases más.
t: And a couple or three more phrases.

o: Inútil que le cuente en detalle mi turbación de esos días.
t: It's pointless for me to tell her in detail about my turmoil in those days.

o: Pero lo que resaltaba claro para mí en su carta--para mí que lo conocía--era la desesperación de celos que lo llevó al suicidio.
t: But what stood out clearly for me in her letter--for I knew him--was the jealous desperation that led him to suicide.

o: Ese era el único motivo; lo demás: sacrificio y conciencia tranquila, no tenía ningún valor.
t: That was the only motive; the rest: sacrifice and a clear conscience, had no value at all.

o: En medio de todo quedaba vivísima, radiante de brusca felicidad, la imagen de María.
t: Amid all of it, the image of María remained vividly alive, radiant with sudden happiness.

o: Yo sé el esfuerzo que debí hacer, cuando era de Vezzera, para dejar de ir a verla.
t: I know the effort I had to make, back when I was at Vezzera, to stop going to see her.

o: Y había creído adivinar también que algo semejante pasaba en ella.
t: And I had believed I could also guess that something similar was happening in her.

o: Y ahora, ¡libres! sí, solos los dos, pero con un cadáver entre nosotros.
t: And now, free! yes, the two of us alone, but with a corpse between us.

o: Después de quince días fui a su casa.
t: Fifteen days later I went to her house.

o: Hablamos vagamente, evitando la menor alusión.
t: We spoke vaguely, avoiding the slightest allusion.

o: Apenas me respondía; y aunque se esforzaba en ello, no podía sostener mi mirada un solo momento.
t: She barely answered me; and even though she tried, she could not hold my gaze for a single moment.

o: --Entonces,--le dije al fin levantándome--creo que lo más discreto es que no vuelva más a verla.
t: "Then," I said at last, standing up, "I think the most discreet thing is for me not to see her again."

o: --Creo lo mismo--me respondió.
t: "I think so too," she answered me.

o: --No, nunca... como usted quiera--rompió en un sollozo, mientras dos lágrimas vencidas rodaban por sus mejillas.
t: "No, never... as you wish," she burst into a sob, while two tears she could not hold back rolled down her cheeks.

o: Al acercarme se llevó las manos a la cara, y apenas sintió mi contacto se estremeció violentamente y rompió en sollozos.
t: As I drew near, she put her hands to her face, and the moment she felt my touch she shuddered violently and broke into sobs.

o: Me incliné detrás de ella y le abracé la cabeza.
t: I leaned over her from behind and held her head in my arms.

o: --Sí, mi alma querida...¿quieres?
t: "Yes, my dear soul... do you want it?"

o: Podremos ser muy felices.
t: We may be very happy.

o: Eso no importa nada...¿quieres?
t: That doesn't matter at all... do you want it?

o: --¡No, no!--me respondió--no podríamos... no, ¡imposible!
t: "No, no!" she answered me. "We couldn't... no, impossible!"

o: --¡Después, sí, mi amor!... ¿Sí, después?
t: "Later, yes, my love!... Later, then?"

o: --¡No, no, no!--redobló aún sus sollozos.
t: "No, no, no!" and her sobs doubled in intensity.

o: Entonces salí desesperado, y pensando con rabiosa amargura que aquel imbécil, al matarse, nos había muerto también a nosotros dos.
t: So I left in desperation, thinking with bitter rage that that fool, by killing himself, had killed the two of us as well.

o: Aquí termina mi novela.
t: Here my novel ends.

o: Ahora, ¿quiere verla?
t: Now, would you like to see her?

o: --¡María!--se dirigió a una joven que pasaba del brazo.--Es hora ya; son las tres.
t: "María!" he addressed a young woman who was passing on his arm. "It's time already; it's three o'clock."

o: --¿Ya? ¿las tres?--se volvió ella.--No hubiera creído.
t: "Already? Three o'clock?" she turned around. "I wouldn't have believed it."

o: Bueno, vamos. Un momentito.
t: Well, let's go. Just a moment.

o: Zapiola me dijo entonces.
t: Zapiola told me then.

o: --Ya ve, amigo mío, como se puede ser feliz después de lo que le he contado.
t: "You see, my friend, how one can be happy after what I've told you."

o: Espere un segundo.
t: Wait a second.

o: Y mientras me presentaba a su mujer.
t: And while I was introduced to his wife.

o: --Le contaba a X cómo estuvimos nosotros a punto de no ser felices.
t: He was telling X how close we had come to not being happy.

o: La joven sonrió a su marido, y reconocí aquellos ojos sombríos de que él me había hablado, y que como todos los de ese carácter, al reir destellan felicidad.
t: The young woman smiled at her husband, and I recognized those somber eyes he had spoken to me of, which, like all eyes of that character, flash with happiness when they laugh.

o: --Sí,--repuso sencillamente--sufrimos un poco...
t: "Yes," she simply replied, "we suffered a little..."

o: --¡Ya ve!--se rió Zapiola despidiéndose.--Yo en lugar suyo volvería al salón.
t: "You see!" Zapiola laughed as he took his leave. "In your place, I'd go back to the parlor."

o: El pensamiento de Elena volvió otra vez; pero en medio de mi disgusto me acordaba a cada instante de la impresión que recibió Zapiola al ver por primera vez los ojos de María.
t: The thought of Elena came back to me again; but in the midst of my vexation I kept remembering the impression Zapiola received when he first saw María's eyes.

o: Y yo no hacía sino recordarlos.
t: And I could do nothing but recall them.
